Version 1.0.1 of afrexai-proposal-engine

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates or changes to functionality or documentation.
- All previous features and instructions remain unchanged.

Initial release — end-to-end proposal engine for service businesses.

- Guides users from qualification to final proposal with detailed frameworks (BANT-Plus, decision matrix, disqualification signals)
- Includes structured templates for discovery notes, value drivers, and decision process extraction
- Provides step-by-step pricing strategy with cost-plus, value-based, and three-tier option models
- Outlines best practices for payment terms across project, retainer, and SaaS engagements
- Supplies a full proposal template: executive summary, structure, and actionable next steps designed to maximize win rates
